data.gender_notes: Sibusiso is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Sibusiso is recorded in name-lists as “Gift of God”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sibusiso expresses “Gift of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sibusiso total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: סיבוסיסו
in_hebrew.meaning: משמעות השם סיבוסיסו לא נמצאה במילון העברי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם סיבוסיסו אינו מופיע במקורות עבריים מסורתיים. ייתכן כי השם מקורו בשפה אחרת.

in_greek.name: Σιβουσισο
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Σιβουσισο δεν βρέθηκε στο ελληνικό λεξικό
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σιβουσισο δεν εμφανίζεται σε παραδοσιακές πηγές ελληνικών ονομάτων. Είναι πιθανόν το όνομα να προέρχεται από άλλη γλώσσα.

in_latin.name: Sibusiso
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Sibusiso non invenitur in lexicis Latinis
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Sibusiso non apparet in fontibus Latinis traditionalibus. Probabile est nomen ex alia lingua originem ducere.
